title: Intermittent schema violation injection and recovery playbook for JSON-mode decoders
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook, automated injection tests, and recovery detectors for intermittent schema violations emitted by models in JSON mode. Goal: detect bursts of malformed or partially emitted JSON across streaming and non-streaming paths, route canary traffic, exercise constrained-decoder backoffs, and ensure automatic graceful fallbacks to compatible model variants without customer-visible errors.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible injection harness that can simulate partial-stream JSON truncation, extra fields, and type-mismatch errors against the current constrained decoder API
Telemetry and alerting that surface schema-violation rate per model/route and trigger an automated canary diversion when threshold breached (configurable)
A recovery path that: 1) retries with relaxed constraint profile; 2) if still failing, switches to a verified fallback model variant and records decision in trace
Integration tests covering streaming+toolcall interleaving with injected schema failures, asserting no uncaught exceptions reach customer SDKs
Runbook documented with play-by-play manual remediation steps, links to dashboards, and postmortem checklist
runbook_steps: Detect: alert fires when schema-violation rate > 0.5% over 5m for a given route/model
Assess: open canary dashboard (link in artifacts) to see sample payloads and top failing prompts
Divert: enable canary-routing (50% of new traffic) to fallback variant and monitor error delta
Mitigate: kick off constrained-decoder soft-relax job (profile: relax-field-types=true, max-missing-keys=2) for the affected route
Escalate: if diversion doesn't reduce customer errors within 10m, open SEV and notify platform reliability
Post-incident: capture failing prompts, update schema or prompt engineering guidance, and add regression case to injection harness
test_matrix: Partial-stream emits: truncated JSON objects at token boundary during streaming response; assert decoder recovers and emits sentinel then fallback
Interleaved toolcall tokens: tool invocation tokens inserted mid-object; assert toolcall parsing preserved and schema recovery path engaged
Type mismatch: numeric field emitted as string in 30% of samples; assert detection and adjustable tolerance metric
Extra unknown keys: burst injection of additional keys; assert policy either drops extras or maps to 'extensions' field per compatibility layer
Latency-sensitive path: simulate constrained-decoder backoff causing increased latency; assert autoscaling and circuit-breaker thresholds prevent client timeouts
notes: Trade-off: aggressive automatic fallback reduces customer-visible errors but can mask model regressions; kept as opt-in per route initially
Decision: threshold defaults tuned conservatively (0.5% over 5m) to avoid noisy canaries; ops can lower for critical customers
Implementation note: reuse existing constrained-decoder backoff logic; add a 'compatibility-mode' flag that records policy metadata in traces
Quality concern: need prompt-sanitizer to avoid recurring malformed outputs caused by prompt content; added to backlog as follow-up
